versions.changelog:
Initial release of Business Masters Skill Matrix.

- Implements 9 modular, programmatically callable business expert modules representing key frameworks of Drucker, Collins, Christensen, Porter, and Munger.
- Each module provides actionable diagnostics and recommendations based on structured business inputs.
- Defines unified input/output formats, parameter validation rules, and return structure (`SkillResult`).
- Includes an integration layer for comprehensive business diagnostics (module M09) routing and aggregation.
- Provides usage instructions for CLI and code-level invocation, with guidance on validation and error handling.
- No external dependencies; runs on Python 3.10+ standard library.

- Initial release of the Business Masters Skill Matrix (v1.0.0).
- Introduces 9 modular, programmatically callable expert modules based on top business thinkers (Drucker, Collins, Christensen, Porter, Munger).
- Unified skill interface with structured input/output, detailed parameter format, and error/status handling.
- Includes an integration layer (M09) for comprehensive diagnosis and routing.
- No external dependencies; requires Python 3.10+ and standard library only.
- Extensive usage documentation and strict input validation for reliable execution.
